attic-legacy.why: sealed before retire; still readable and completable after retirement

relay-early.why: unique sealed record; recomputes byte-for-byte from snapshot 00-public-sample

relay-lost.why: sealed record exists although its page response was lost; the journal shows the night-a request and the repository row, and it recomputes from snapshot 01

relay-retry.why: identical content to relay-lost but no evidence ties it to the original operator; it proves a candidate sample only

attic-fresh-sample.why: attic v1 is retired and cannot seal; a new sample needs a fresh source read and a new version

relay-retargeted-closure.why: only a live preview exists after the relationship target moved; a preview is not a record
